title.zh: OKX 向美国 SEC 提交申请，拟推出代币化股票交易
title.en: OKX Files with SEC to Bring Tokenized-Stock Trading to the US

current_state.zh: OKX has submitted a filing to the US SEC seeking approval to offer tokenized-stock trading to US customers, advancing its push into tokenized equities.
current_state.en: OKX has submitted a filing to the US SEC seeking approval to offer tokenized-stock trading to US customers, advancing its push into tokenized equities.

updates.what_changed_zh: OKX and Intercontinental Exchange, the NYSE's parent company, are pursuing a US tokenized stock trading platform that would initially cover 63 equities.
